page: Amazon Web Services m8id.24xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 5700 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieves top-tier status in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core tests, and Passmark CPU scores, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics tests. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, scoring in the top tier for read-only operations on both small and large blocks. The CPU architecture supports advanced vector and matrix extensions, which contribute to top-tier performance in LLM inference prompt processing across small, medium, and large models, as well as software compilation and ray tracing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the m8id.24xlarge offers a balanced resource density, combining high-capacity DDR5 memory with substantial local NVMe SSD storage on a dedicated hardware profile. This balance makes it highly suitable for resource-intensive workloads that require rapid local data access and high computational throughput. Recommended workloads include large-scale database operations, Redis deployments, static web serving, software compilation, and LLM prompt processing.
